Name: Oral Allergy Syndrome
Author: DolphinWhisperer9
Description:
Oral Allergy Syndrome is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21238]BarleyZP's Allergies[/url] mod that adds in 9 new allergy types to choose or discover. 

People with Oral Allergy Syndrome (OAS), like myself, are allergic to pollens that have a correlation to specific foods. Eating these foods then cause allergic reactions, with effects ranging from just a slightly itchy throat all the way up to anaphylaxis. Some pollens don't trigger reactions in some people, or they trigger a lesser reaction compared to a different allergen. 

This content pack simulates OAS by adding 9 different pollens:
[list]
[*]Birch
[*]Ragweed
[*]Mugwort
[*]Weeds (a pollen category comprised of 7 common weed types, none of which are cannabis)
[*]Parietaria
[*]Grasses
[*]Alder
[*]Cedar
[*]Plane Tree
[/list]These are some of the most common pollens associated with OAS.

Each of these pollens includes a "cooked" toggle in the config (highly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for ease). Since raw foods (at least for me) have a tendency to cause more issues than cooked foods, unchecking the Cooked toggle means that only the raw foods for that particular pollen will cause a reaction in the player and cooked foods are safe. Please note, it (currently) isn't possible to toggle only cooked foods and leave out the raw ones. If I find a way to make this happen in the future I'll include it in an update.

While you definitely can use the Randomized Allergy option in the base allergy mod with this content pack, it will throw all 9 pollens into the randomizer and potentially make things much, much harder depending on the ones the randomizer chooses. If you want a slightly easier time, just select the ones you want in the main Allergy menu instead.

This pack is compatible with items from:
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded
[*]Ridgeside Village
[*]Sunberry Village
[*]Visit Mount Vapius
[*]Cornucopia
[*]Love of Cooking
[*]Wildflour's Atelier Goods
[*]Lilybrook
[*]Cape Stardew
[*]Downtown Zuzu
[*]Stardew Aquarium
[/list]If there's enough interest in adding other mod compatibility I'll add their items as well.

[u]To install:[/u]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
This is my first completed mod and I'm not a coder by trade so this was made with a lot of trial and error! I did my best to include as many accurate foods as possible from more common mods. However, if you find that I missed a food that should've been included, please let me know and I'll correct it. Same thing with bugs. I can't guarantee that I'll be able to fix a bug due to my lack of knowledge but I'll do my best!


[i]If you like this mod, please consider checking out my other work. I made this in my free time but I'm mainly a digital artist. You can find my previous artwork on my site, [url=http://artfullyyoursartwork.com]artfullyyoursartwork.com[/url]! If you so choose, you can also [url=https://buymeacoffee.com/artfullyyours]buy me a coffee[/url]! Thanks everyone!
